criterionAssessments.rationale: Search-first UI is easy for research questions; less of a project/GPT workshop than ChatGPT.
Cited research LLM assistant — a peer inside llm-assistant, not a writing-only or voice tool.
Pro Search and Deep Research with citations are the quality story; not a lab bake-off vs ChatGPT.
Spaces, files, Labs, and Computer (higher tiers) add depth beyond one-shot search.
Slack, API/Sonar, and file Spaces cover research workflows; thinner Office-native depth than Copilot.
Enterprise Pro publishes SSO/admin and no-training claims; consumer tiers are weaker.
Free → Pro → Max → Enterprise ladder exists; Max is expensive for casual teams.
Pro at $20 matches ChatGPT Plus for research-heavy users; Max is a steep step. Affiliate economics excluded.
Model switching on Pro/Max is competitive; capability is research-shaped rather than agent-OS-shaped.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine AI editorial criteria using category weights (AI job fit 16, output quality 14, ease of use 12, workflow depth 12, integrations 10, governance/privacy 10, value 10, model capability 8, scalability 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — LLM assistants, writing, voice, presentations, websites, ad creative, and agent builders are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
